# Upload fixtures

§13.4 archive validators round-trip canonical upload bodies. The
fixtures here are the test corpus the §13.4 + §12.2.3 File Fabric
tests load.

Layout:
- `multipart/simple.body` — minimal multipart POST body (one file
  part, one form field). Used to verify the gateway parses
  multipart/form-data correctly.
- `multipart/archive.body` — multipart body containing a small
  tar.gz archive as the file part. Used to verify the upload pipe
  recognises archives by content-type + extension.
- `archives/clean.tar.gz` — well-formed tar.gz with two safe files.
  Round-trips through `pkg/upload.ValidateArchive`.
- `archives/bomb-deep.tar` — many nested directories (depth > 8).
  Expected to fail with `ARCHIVE_DEPTH_EXCEEDED`.
- `archives/bomb-count.tar` — high entry count above the per-archive
  cap. Expected to fail with `ARCHIVE_ENTRY_COUNT_EXCEEDED`.
- `archives/path-traversal.tar` — entry with `../` in the path.
  Expected to fail with `ARCHIVE_PATH_TRAVERSAL`.
- `archives/setuid.tar` — entry with mode 4755. Expected to fail
  with `ARCHIVE_SETUID_FORBIDDEN`.

Archive fixtures are generated by `scripts/regen-upload-fixtures.sh`
when they need to be refreshed. They're checked in as binary blobs
so tests don't depend on Go's tar/gzip output bit-for-bit (which
varies across versions).
